nodes.long_description:
# OWN THE STREETS OF VENROVA BAY

Viper Vice is a single-player open-world crime sandbox built for VR. Explore a neon-soaked 1980s city where you can physically hijack vehicles, rob stores and banks, fight rival gangs and escape a reactive police wanted system.

{1062232166397259}


# 3 GANGS. 70 STORY MISSIONS.

Choose who you work for, build your reputation and take on 70 story missions across the city—or ignore the story and make your own trouble in the open world.

{2982410995425010}


# BUILD YOUR ARSENAL

Earn cash, find weapons and supplies, and customize your guns with suppressors, sights, scopes, lasers, flashlights, extended magazines and more.

{1091901126592931}

# MORE THAN MISSIONS

Drive cars, bikes and motorcycles. Take side jobs, explore interiors, rob businesses, fight for territory or simply cruise around Venrova Bay at your own pace.


**Offline single-player. Built for Meta Quest 2, Quest 3 and Quest 3S.**
nodes.short_description: Viper Vice is a single-player open-world crime sandbox built for VR and set in the 1980s. Hijack cars and motorcycles, rob stores and banks, fight rival gangs, evade the police, customize weapons, take on side jobs, and play through 70 story missions across Venrova Bay.

nodes.long_description:
**Viper Vice** throws you into the heart of a city ruled by power struggles and shifting alliances. As a skilled mercenary, you’ll navigate high-stakes missions, forge relationships with influential figures, and carve out your own path in a world where every decision matters. Will you outmaneuver your rivals, build your reputation, and rise to the top? The city is yours to explore—just be ready for the consequences of your actions.

# Main Features:
- **Dynamic Missions:** Take on high-risk jobs, from securing valuable assets to outsmarting rival factions. Strategy and reputation will determine your opportunities.

- **Allies & Rivals:** Build trust with powerful figures or face opposition from those who seek to control the city. Your choices will shape your standing in this unpredictable world.

- **Unlock Vehicles & Gear:** Earn and customize a variety of high-performance vehicles and cutting-edge equipment to stay ahead of the competition.

- **Reputation Matters:** Prove your skills and gain influence. The more respect you earn, the more challenging—and rewarding—your opportunities become.

- **Urban Takeover:** Expand your influence across the city through strategic alliances and calculated decisions. Every move you make affects the balance of power.

Step into the immersive world of Viper Vice, where ambition, strategy, and survival define your journey. Will you thrive in this high-stakes urban battleground, or will the city consume you? The choice is yours.
nodes.short_description: Viper Vice throws you into a gritty, crime-ridden city where you’re a mercenary for hire. Work for powerful gangs, complete high-stakes missions, steal cars, and rise through the underworld ranks. Build alliances or make enemies, as each decision changes the city’s dynamic. Unlock weapons, vehicles, and properties as you earn money and respect. In this fast-paced, open-world VR experience, you’ll need to outsmart and outgun rivals to claim the streets as your own.

nodes.change_log:
Patch 14 - The Living City Update is now live!
Version: 0.8.4

This update adds the weather system, New Game+ and a lot of other changes.

Enjoy!

WEATHER SYSTEM:
* Venrova bay now see Rainy, Stormy, Snowy, Cloudy, Clear and Foggy weather.
* When it rains the windows of the cars get wet and droplets appear.
* Sound of rain hitting the car, when inside the car.
* It's harder for the player to control the vehicle depending on how much it rains or snows.
* You can manually change the weather in the cheat menu.

NEW GAME+:
* If you complete the game you have the option to start New Game+ with all unlocked items and weapons carrying over.

MENU ADJUSTMENTS:
* While driving, if you open the in game menu, it now shows a mini map instead of the full menu.
* Clicking exit game in the ingame menu brings you to the main menu instead of existing the game.
* clicking New Game now automatically chooses an empty save slot, if any.

NPC BEHAVIOURS:
* Implemented a master stimulation system, that records every gunshot, dead people, explosions, car crashes, fleeing people.
* Pedestrians react to these events.
* If pedestrians see dead body they might scream and run away.
* Pedestrians might look at distant gunfire or just run away.
* Pedestrians stop and look at car crashes.
* Panic spreads, if pedestrians are fleeing, other pedestrians might see it and also flee.
* Every NPC (pedestrians, gangs, police, vendors, drivers) will look at you when you get near them (if they are in a casual state). They will not stare, just glance.
* Drivers might use the vehicle horn, if you or someone else is blocking their path.
* Drivers now have more behaviours for panic: they might speed away, they might freeze, they might exit their car and run.
* Drivers now put their hands up when you aim at them.
* Drivers if they crash, might exit their car and flee the scene.
* Police now also target gang members. They tell gangs to "drop weapons" and "hands up". if the gang member doesn't comply or kill someone, then the cop begins shooting. Your heat level still takes priority.
* Beach is now empty at night or during rainy/snowy weather
* Generally fewer civilians at night or in bad weather. gang presents is now higher during the night.
* There is a chance of npcs collapsing and bleeding out. You can let them be or take them out.

ITEMS:
* Added in cigarettes. Can be found in safehouse. can be lit by lighter, gunfire, molotov fire, another lit cigarette, burning people, burning vehicles. Rain will put out the lit cigarettes unless below roof or holding hand over the cigarette.
* Added zippo lighter you can use to light up your cigarette.
* Added ability to hide armour visuals (still keeping the health bonus) in the settings.

ADJUSTMENTS:
* Reduced the number of stars during the night.
* Muffled engine sound when player inside vehicle and doors closed.
* Made it easier to control motorcycles and turn corners. Even easier if you enable bike leaning in the settings.

FIXES:
* Made fixes to the UI so its easier to use
* Fixed issue with players being offset when seated on motorcycles and bikes.
* Fixed issue where the passengers in taxis would jitter, while driving fast.
* Fixed issue with the city blocks not loading sometimes
* Fixed issue with mission restarting when taking the payphone, while the current mission is still running.
* Fixed mission progress not being saved or given to rival gang.
* Fixed issues with fetch missions getting stuck after retry.
* fixed issue with NPCs not being able to see you in cars.
* fixed issue with looted weapon attachments disappearing from weapons when entering buildings.
* fixed issue with NPCs not reacting when shot by a silenced weapon.

OPTIMIZATIONS:
* changed how UI is displayed, going with a more optimized approach.
* optimized the "who is aiming at me" behaviours of the npcs.
* optimized the sound and hearing system.
* optimized smart objects
* Combat Optimizations
* Weather Optimizations
* optimized npcs
* Enabled Foveation. You can disable or increase it in settings. 
* Optimized some textures and meshes.
* Removed unused meshes and textures so they are not included in the build.

Patch 13 of Viper Vice is now Live

This update adds new weapons and the attachment system.


New Weapons:
- Tec9
- Mac-10
- Micro Draco
- Switchblade (click trigger to extend and retract blade)
- [SECRET] - Unlocked by completing easter egg #2


Attachment System:
- You can now buy attachments and upgrades for your weapons at S Guns. You can only buy attachments if you have unlocked the weapon.
- Attachments & Upgrades: Reddot, Navtech, Supressor, Switch (semi auto to auto converter), extended mag, drum mag, laser sight, hollow point ammo, armor piecing ammo.
- Random weapons spawned around the world will now sometimes spawn with attachments.

General:
- Adjusted and rebalanced all prices on all weapons and ammo
- Adjusted Firing rate on all automatic weapons and weapons that become automatic after adding converter attachment.
- Updated the sound FX on all weapons
- Magazines now slide in and out on weapons that make sense to have it.
- Easter Egg #2
- Fixed missing collider on dumpster ramp
- Fixed missing collider in safehouse
- Fixed issue with muzzle effect not showing sometimes when shooting automatic weapons
- Fixed issue with safes not being detected as unlocked in the "Dollar Cocktail" Mission.

* FIX: NPCs should driver better now and stay on road, unless they panic
